quotes.name: Daniel Yoon
quotes.quote: I just picked up a new A's jersey. Honestly, I'm still riding the high from that win last night.

quotes.name: Janelle Rourke
quotes.quote: I bought a new A's jersey and, honestly, it's been really exciting to put it on. There's this sense of anticipation hanging in the air that I just can't shake. I'm looking forward to the next season, maybe even catching a game or two.

quotes.name: Inga Creator
quotes.quote: I'm still on cloud nine after last night's win! I celebrated by buying a new A's jersey - it's my way of showing team spirit. The energy around here is electric, and I'm loving every minute of it.

claim: I just picked up a new A's jersey. Honestly, I'm still riding the high from that win last night.
